uzma-afzal--rmit.notes: Personal site (uzmaafzal.com) states 'I am a Lecturer (Assistant Professor) at the School of Economics, Finance and Marketing (EFM) at RMIT, Australia'. It does not list the paper, so identity rests on the RePEc profile. NBER profile still lists NYUAD (described as outdated); VoxDev and IGC list LUMS / Lahore School of Economics (older). Australian Lecturer is treated as a tenure-line post.
